about_the_game:
Terraforming on this planet was abandoned by the government, leaving settlers with nothing but broken promises. But you refused to accept this fate and chose to take your destiny into your own hands.

Idle Terra is a sci-fi idle strategy in isometric view. You are given a plot of land on the planet to explore cell by cell. On the grid, 3D buildings appear, each generating resources and supporting your progress. Visiting ships purchase what you produce, opening new opportunities for expansion.

The goal is to explore the entire plot and transform a wild, untamed land into a thriving space shaped by your work and strategy. Build power plants, processing factories, and other facilities, and hire ships for trade to strengthen your progress.

Play at your own pace: launch processes, pause, or even leave the game running overnight to return with fresh resources. Step by step, you will explore every cell and gain control of your section of this nameless planet.
